bg: A wide 16:9 view inside a town hall museum room during a festival: polished wooden floor, tall arched windows on the right showing heavy rain outside, an empty glass display case on a pedestal against the back wall, old framed paintings on the walls, colourful festival bunting hanging from the ceiling, a wide open doorway on the left.

a 17 year old art student named Oskar, light skin, messy blond hair, glasses, a grey hoodie, a camera on a strap around his neck, jeans
